chapter.li: LEChapter8 Verse1 Then Alma returned from the land of Gideon after teaching Gideon’s people far too much to be written, having organized the congregation like he did before in Zarahemla. He went back to his own house at Zarahemla to rest. VerseEnd Verse2 So the ninth year of the judges’ rule over the Nephites ended. VerseEnd

Verse3 At the start of the 10th year, Alma went to Melek, west of the Sidon River, on the western border of the wilderness. VerseEnd Verse4 He began teaching there conforming to his calling in the Holy Order of God, teaching the people throughout the land of Melek. VerseEnd

Verse5 The people came to him to be baptized from the entire area, including the outskirts of the land near the wilderness. VerseEnd Verse6 When he finished his work at Melek, he left there and traveled three days to the north of the land of Melek, arriving at a city called Ammonihah. VerseEnd Verse7 Now it was the Nephites’ custom to call their lands, cities, and villages, even their small villages, after the person who first settled there.

This was true of the land of Ammonihah. VerseEnd Verse8 Once Alma arrived at Ammonihah, he began to preach God’s word to them. VerseEnd Verse9 Now Satan had a firm hold on the hearts of the people of the city of Ammonihah; therefore they refused to listen to Alma. VerseEnd Verse10 Despite this, Alma looked to heaven for help, pleading with God to intervene, humbly asking for Him to help influence the people to open their hearts and see their need for repentance and baptism. VerseEnd Verse11 But they hardened their hearts and told him: We know 2PSI you’re Alma, and we know 2PSI you’re the high priest over the congregation, which 2PSI you’ve established in many parts of the land based on 2PP your tradition. But we aren’t part of 2PSI your congregation, and we don’t believe in such foolish traditions. VerseEnd Verse12 Because we don’t belong to 2PSI your congregation, we know 2PSI you don’t have any power over us. 2PSI You’ve handed over the judgment seat to Nephihah, therefore 2PSI you’re no longer the chief judge over us. VerseEnd Verse13 When the people said this and rejected everything he said and ridiculed him, spit on him, and had him thrown out of their city, he left there and traveled toward a city named Aaron. VerseEnd

Verse14 While he was on his way there, mourning and agonizing about the wickedness of the people in Ammonihah, while lamenting his failure, an angel of the Lord appeared to him, saying: VerseEnd Verse15 Alma, 2PSI you are blessed. So look up and rejoice, because 2PSI you have every reason to rejoice, since 2PSI you’ve faithfully kept God’s commandments from His first message to 2PSI you. I’m the one who delivered it to 2PSI you. VerseEnd Verse16 I now am sent to command 2PSI you to return to Ammonihah and preach to them again, warning them that unless they repent, the Lord God will destroy them. VerseEnd Verse17 The Lord wants 2PSI you to know that right now they’re conspiring about how to destroy the freedom of 2PSI your people. They violate the statutes, judgments, and commandments God has given His people. VerseEnd

Verse18 After Alma heard this from the angel of the Lord, he returned quickly to Ammonihah. He entered Ammonihah by a different way, on the south side of the city. VerseEnd Verse19 Because he was hungry when he entered, he asked a man: Will 2PSF you give a humble servant of God something to eat? VerseEnd Verse20 The man replied: I’m a Nephite and I know 2PSI you’re a holy prophet of God. 2PSI You’re the man an angel told me in a vision I would meet and help. Come with me to my house, and I’ll feed 2PSI you. I know 2PSI you’ll bring a blessing for my household and me. VerseEnd Verse21 The man named Amulek took him into his house. He gave Alma bread and meat to eat. VerseEnd

Verse22 Then Alma ate bread until he was full; and he blessed Amulek and his household, and thanked God. VerseEnd Verse23 After eating his fill, he told Amulek: I’m Alma; I’m the high priest over the congregations of God throughout the land. VerseEnd Verse24 I was called by the spirit of revelation and prophecy to preach God’s word to all these people. I was here before but they were unwilling to listen to me, and they threw me out. I was about to turn my back on this land forever. VerseEnd Verse25 But I’ve been commanded to return and prophesy to the people and testify against their iniquities. VerseEnd Verse26 Now Amulek, because 2PSI you’ve fed me and taken me in, 2PSI you are blessed. I was hungry because I had fasted for many days. VerseEnd Verse27 Alma stayed with Amulek for many days before he began to preach to the people. VerseEnd

Verse28 Meanwhile the people grew more shameless in their iniquities. VerseEnd Verse29 Then the Lord told Alma: Go. Also, tell my servant Amulek: Go out and prophesy to the people, saying: Repent, because this warning is from the Lord: Unless 2PP you repent, I’ll punish 2PP you people in My anger; and I won’t abandon My fierce anger. VerseEnd Verse30 Then Alma and Amulek went to tell the people God’s warning to them. And they were filled with the Holy Ghost. VerseEnd Verse31 They had God’s power and they couldn’t be confined in dungeons or killed. Nevertheless, they didn’t use their power until after they were tied up and thrown in prison, and only then to show the Lord’s power was with them. VerseEnd
Verse32 They went to preach and prophesy to the people obeying the Spirit and using the power the Lord gave them. VerseEnd
